title: Three Terms and One Short Tube
subtitle: 垃圾处理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 垃圾处理（人与自然·环境保护·废物与处理）
meta: 主题语境：垃圾处理（人与自然·环境保护·废物与处理）　|　核心词汇：pollution　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pollution 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the researcher ① cut the pollution that no student in the lab would have noted, and he said the cutting was the whole of the term. The ② pollution, meaning the waste itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed unnoted in the book; pollution, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ sample of pollution in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ pollution at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Pollution, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the researcher said the noting is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pollution was the whole of the matter, meaning the harm and not the waste. The ⑥ pollution, meaning the harm and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; pollution, he said, is either something you cut or the only word that means both waste and a harm. He said the harm is the part they remember.

By 1987 the ⑦ pollution had become a line in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ pollution of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in February, was one lab and three terms of noting; pollution, he said, is either the sample at the far bench or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pollution I remember is the pollution noted in the paper, which closed in 1989 and is still noted as the quietest in the lab. ⑩ Pollution, my mother said in 1991, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all pollution, she said, is a harm that has agreed to look like waste. She said the harm was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 污染（指实验室里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 污染（指那种污染本身，与细细的试管相对）
C. 固定搭配：cut the pollution 减少这一种污染
D. n. 污染（指留给孩子们测的那一份）
E. n. 污染之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的污染之事）
F. n. 污染（指研究报告里写到、被记下的那一种）
G. n. 污染、祸患（指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 祸患（抽象总称，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cut the pollution that no student in the lab would have noted
The pollution, meaning the waste itself and not the tube
Every sample of pollution in that lab
the pollution at the far bench
the pollution was the whole of the matter
the pollution had become a line in a paper
The pollution of the whole thing

answers.why: cut the pollution 意为“减少这一种污染”，1982 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位学生肯记下的一种污染做了一遍。
pollution 意为“污染”，指那种污染本身而不是细细的试管，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。
pollution 意为“污染”，指实验室里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一支细细的试管。
pollution 意为“污染”，指最远那张实验台的留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pollution 意为“污染、祸患”，指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种祸患就是那件事的全部。
pollution 意为“祸患”，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种污染，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pollution 意为“污染”，指研究报告里写到、被记下的那一种，到 1987 年这一种成了研究报告里的一行。
pollution 意为“污染之事”，研究员二月写道，整件事的污染之事是一处实验室和三个学期的记下。
pollution 意为“污染”，我记得的是研究报告里记下过的那一种，1989 年测定了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一种。
pollution 为抽象总称，母亲 1991 年说，污染是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的污染。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1982 年那位研究员减少了实验室里没有一位学生肯记下的一种污染，他说这一遍才是那个学期的全部。（cut the pollution）
那种污染，指的是那种污染本身而不是细细的试管，经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。（pollution）
那处实验室里每一份污染旁边都有同一支细细的试管。（pollution）
最远那张实验台那种污染，指的是他们留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（pollution）
叔叔说这种祸患就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那种污染。（pollution）
1991 年母亲说，污染是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的污染。（pollution）
